QUILLFEATHER NOTES: TERMS OF SERVICE
Effective 1 May 2026. This is a synthetic document written for the small-print tests; Quillfeather is not a real company or product.

1. The Agreement
Quillfeather Labs LLC ("Quillfeather", "we", "us") provides the Quillfeather note-taking app (the "App").
You must be 18 or older to use the App.

2. Subscriptions
Quillfeather Pro is billed yearly and will be automatically renewed for successive one-year terms.
All subscription fees are final and non-refundable.
Quillfeather reserves the right to increase subscription prices at any time.
We will email you at least 30 days before a price increase applies to you.

3. Your Notes
You retain all rights in the notes you write.
By publishing a note, you grant us a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide licence to reproduce, adapt and distribute it.
We may use your notes to train our machine-learning models.
You can export all of your notes at any time.

4. Privacy
We may disclose your personal information to advertisers and marketing partners.
We never sell your personal information.
We share your personal data with service providers who process it on our behalf.
We and our partners use cookies and similar technologies to show you interest-based ads.
You can turn off personalised ads in Settings.

5. Ending Your Account
Quillfeather may deactivate your account for any reason, without prior notice.
You may close your account at any time.

6. Changes
Quillfeather reserves the right to amend this Agreement at any time.
By continuing to use the App after a change, you agree to the amended Agreement.

7. Liability
The App is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind.
Under no circumstances will Quillfeather be liable for lost profits or lost notes.
Our aggregate liability shall not exceed fifty euros.
You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Quillfeather from any claim arising from your notes.

8. Disputes
All disputes will be settled exclusively through binding arbitration.
You agree to bring claims only on an individual basis, and you waive any right to a jury trial.
Nothing in these terms prevents you from reporting us to a consumer authority.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Examplia.

9. Contact
Write to legal@quillfeather.example.
